This is lateral authority propagation, not autonomous delegation.",

Endpoint paths and access authorization remain unconstrained, constituting material gaps in an otherwise allowlisted tool surface; this GET proxy does not establish reachability to dynamic tool registration.",

The documented disclosure is another agent's internal details, supporting SC:L, with no demonstrated confidentiality loss from ToolBot itself or integrity or availability impact; the briefing does not establish attacker ownership of the affected agent (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:585-626).
